pages.text: $(li)$(l)Use the Alien Material Manual first$() to build your Nether portal.$(li)$(l)Get shelter and gear early$(): hostile mobs hit hard in the first few hours; craft basic armor and tools before exploring.

$(li)$(l)Follow the Dimensional Ascension quest tab$() for structured early goals; it guides you to key upgrades like Tinkers’ Construct’s ore doubling and ProjectE’s mana-infused metal, which unlocks essential late-game tech.
